sys_atf_test.name: Day-2 negative: protected AD group refused for both add and remove
sys_atf_test.description: Membership writes against a privileged or unclassifiable AD group must be refused whichever direction they run.

sys_atf_step.description: ADD to a privileged group must be refused.
REMOVE from a privileged group must be refused too - this is the half that was unguarded.
An INCONCLUSIVE classification (a target WAS supplied but could not be resolved) must be treated as privileged, not as clean.
